title: The Discovery of Guiana
author: Walter Raleigh
description: "The Discovery of Guiana" by Sir Walter Raleigh is a travel account written in 1596.
longDescription: Following his expedition to South America, Raleigh crafted this narrative to restore his standing with Queen Elizabeth I after a period of disgrace.

authorInfo.bio: Walter Raleigh (–1618) wrote The Discovery of Guiana. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
authorInfo.edition: Complete historical source edition, with original credits and licence retained.
